name: tavily-research
description: Research a topic in depth with Tavily. Use this skill when a question needs many sources gathered and weighed together: analysing a market, policy, technology or trend, comparing options across several criteria, reviewing the literature, or any request to research, investigate or analyze something in depth. A single fact or answer to find, even one with many clues, is a tavily-search task. For one CRM record use tavily-entity, for a table of matches use tavily-list, and for a recurring check use tavily-monitor.

findings.excerpt: `npx skills add tavily-ai/skills --skill tavily-search` and read its SKILL.md
